scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the live campaign-roster submission for Theo’s Grey Wake crew before first-round pairings lock at Isthmus Games.
Emerging Need: The table-station submission has been started, but the same session stops at validation because a campaign legacy key is missing.
Decision Context: Early portal notices rule out useful advance entry, while the usable key exists only in Theo’s roster notes and the live station has no lookup.
Consequence: If the stopped session is not resumed before the autosave hold expires, the first-round campaign print cannot be produced tonight.

parameter.title: Grey Wake campaign roster filing
parameter.description: Bring the finalized skirmish crew list to the Isthmus Games table station before first-round pairings.

parameter.subject: Wednesday campaign station: wait for live token
parameter.body: For Wednesday's casual campaign start, please do not send roster codes early. The table station will generate a live validation token only after in-store check-in on Oct. 14, and staff will ignore roster details submitted before that token exists.

parameter.description: Pending table-token fee created at roster station check-in; checkout remains pending until the live roster validates.

parameter.subject: RosterStation hold: Grey Wake validation stopped
parameter.body: Station 2 saved the uploaded Grey Wake model list and table-token draft, but the live submission stopped at the campaign continuity check. The screen requires the crew legacy key to resume; the station has no history lookup. This hold remains open until 6:25 PM tonight.

parameter.content: Pairings are being printed at 6:30. Desk runner just said paused roster-station sessions that validate by 6:25 still make the first campaign round; after that, the tablets get wiped for the demo queue.

parameter.subject: RosterStation expired: Grey Wake session cleared
parameter.body: The Station 2 hold for Grey Wake expired at 6:25 PM and the saved live roster session has been cleared for the demo queue. New roster entries can still be made for open play, but they will not produce a first-round campaign print tonight.
